editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The caveats about exponential cost and deep circuits on noisy hardware are kept, and gate→Gatter, circuit→Schaltkreis and "einzelnes CX-Gatter" are correct and used consistently. Two word-choice slips: the English noun "unitary" is carried over as the bare noun "Unitäre" ("Klassen von Unitären", "die zu implementierende Unitäre", "der Unitären" in [13]), where a German physicist would normally write "unitäre Operatoren/Matrizen". Also, "run on noisy quantum computers" becomes "Betrieb auf", where "Ausführung auf" is the usual wording.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner, but a native editor would polish a few phrases. In [8], "Stichprobennahme eines Quantum Circuit auf einem QPU" uses the wrong gender (a QPU is normally feminine: "einer QPU") and an unusual noun ("Stichprobenentnahme" or simply "Sampling" is more idiomatic). In [11], "zwei-Qubit Bell-Zustand" breaks German compound rules ("Zwei-Qubit-Bell-Zustand"). The option descriptions calque English "takes": "Nimmt eine ganze Zahl" and "Nimmt ein Tupel" in [17], [18] and [20] should be "Erwartet …". In [24], "auf einem Quantenzustand" copies the English "on" and reads more naturally as "für einen Quantenzustand".

"Tetrahedral" appears as both "tetraedralen" and "tetraedrische" ([50]). editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, and nothing here would mislead a learner. The key terms are consistent: Kanal, positiv semidefinit, Dichtematrix, Sammlung von Matrizen and Ausspuren. editor_note: Two hedged forecasts become flat facts. In [13], "is how we believe the community will reach quantum advantage" loses "we believe" and now says outright that the community will get there this way. In [18], "is not expected to be viable in the immediate near term" becomes "ist … noch nicht realisierbar", which also uses the odd spatial calque "im unmittelbaren Nahbereich". In [8], "quantum separation" is rendered "Quantenüberlegenheit", the usual German term for quantum supremacy, a different concept from the separation criterion in the paper being cited. Smaller problems: a case error in [11] ("um Rechenproblemen zu bewältigen"), a wrongly capitalized adjective in [4] ("Quantenklassischen Computing"), and "Quantum Circuits" in [4] while every other entry uses "Quantenschaltkreise".

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner. Core terms are correct and used the same way throughout: Hamiltonoperator, Erzeugungs-/Vernichtungsoperatoren, aktiver Raum and Jordan-Wigner-Mapping. Three small edits remain. In [41], "Energie eines elektronischen Kerns" is a literal rendering that sits right next to "Kernabstoßung" (nuclear repulsion), so a reader can take it for the atomic nucleus. "Rumpf" (core, as in Rumpfelektronen) is the usual German term. In [36], "Multi-Konfiguration-Self-Consistent-Fields-Paket" is a clumsy hyphen chain, and [25] switches to plural "euch" in a page that otherwise addresses the reader as "du".

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, including the kernel trick, the primal and dual forms, and the reasons for non-linearity in QNNs, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The heading [37] renders "Quantum kernels" as "Quantenkerne", but the body always says "Quantenkernel"/"Kernel", so the terms don't match and "Kern" is the wrong ML term. A few hedges were dropped: "may be possible" became "ist es möglich" [33], "might still be … computable" became "wäre dennoch … berechenbar" [33], and "clusters the algorithm might identify" became "die vom Algorithmus identifizierten Cluster" [8]. There are also some calques: "die klassische Machine-Learning-Einstellung" for "setting" [12], "vieles der Nuancen" [4], "Kostengröße" [55] and "Mid-Circuit Messungen" without the hyphen [58].

editor_note: Entry [23] reverses the instruction. The English says the simulator lines "can be un-commented", but the German says "können ... auskommentiert werden", which means "commented out".
